commands.review_summary:
The PR replaces five raw memory-core dreaming snippet `.slice(0, N)` truncations with `truncateUtf16Safe` and adds a surrogate-boundary Vitest proof plus a standalone proof script.

PR surface: Source +7, Tests +190, Other +89. Total +286 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: current main uses raw UTF-16 `.slice` at the affected daily and session truncation sites, and a two-code-unit emoji straddling the cut point leaves a lone surrogate. I did not execute a full current-main repro in this read-only review.

target.title: [AI] fix(memory): use truncateUtf16Safe for dreaming snippet truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where dreaming snippet truncation in `memory-core` can produce invalid UTF-16 output. When a complex emoji or surrogate pair straddles the 280-character truncation boundary, `.slice(0, 280)` cuts between the high and low surrogate code units, producing a lone surrogate that can cause display corruption, JSON encoding failures, or database rejections downstream.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace all 5 `.slice(0, N)` calls in `extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-phases.ts` with `truncateUtf16Safe` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/memory-core-host-engine-foundation` (the standard SDK facade, already used by `manager-search.ts` in the same extension). `truncateUtf16Safe` checks whether the cut position falls inside a surrogate pair (high surrogate `0xD800–0xDBFF` followed by low surrogate `0xDC00–0xDFFF`) and drops the orphaned high surrogate. The change is +6/-5 in a single file.

## User Impact

None for typical text content. For memory content that happens to contain an emoji or complex Unicode character at the truncation boundary, the dreaming snippet no longer includes a lone surrogate character, preventing potential downstream encoding issues.

## Evidence

**Environment**: Linux x86_64, Node v24.13.1, OpenClaw 2026.6.11.

### 1. Lone surrogate reproduction at the 280-char boundary

Both `DAILY_INGESTION_MAX_SNIPPET_CHARS` and `SESSION_INGESTION_MAX_SNIPPET_CHARS` are `280` (`dreaming-phases.ts:99,109`). With emoji at position 279–280, `.slice(0, 280)` produces a lone high surrogate (`0xD83D`) while `truncateUtf16Safe` drops it cleanly:

```
$ node --import tsx scripts/proof/dreaming-surrogate-truncation-proof.mjs

=== Dreaming Snippet Truncation Proof: Emoji at Truncation Boundary ===

Each call site constructed so the emoji surrogate pair straddles the
truncation boundary, testing truncateUtf16Safe edge behavior.

Before fix — slice(0,280) on 'A'.repeat(279)+'😀': 280 code units, lone surrogate: YES (0xD83D)

--- All 5 call sites after fix (truncateUtf16Safe) ---

  PASS  normalizeDailyHeading (truncation at 280)
        input:  281 code units (truncated), emoji at [279-280]
        output: 279 code units
  PASS  normalizeDailySnippet (truncation at 280)
        input:  281 code units (truncated), emoji at [279-280]
        output: 279 code units
  PASS  buildDailyChunkSnippet (truncation at 280)
        input:  281 code units (truncated), emoji at [279-280]
        output: 279 code units
  PASS  normalizeSessionCorpusSnippet (truncation at 280)
        input:  281 code units (truncated), emoji at [279-280]
        output: 279 code units
  PASS  buildSessionRenderedLine (truncation at 344)
        input:  345 code units (truncated), emoji at [343-344]
        output: 343 code units

Result: All 5 call sites produce clean UTF-16 — zero lone surrogates.
```

### 2. Real dreaming sweep — generated artifact output

A full dreaming sweep (`runDreamingSweepPhases`, light + rem) was run with emoji at the post-prefix 280-char boundary. Input: daily note line `"- " + 279x + 🌍` (stripped = 281 chars), session message `279y + 🌍` (281 chars).

**Generated daily markdown** (`memory/2026-07-08.md`, 1000 bytes):
```
<!-- openclaw:dreaming:light:start -->
- Candidate: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx...xxxxxxxxxxx;
  - confidence: 0.62
  - evidence: memory/2026-07-08.md:3-4
  - recalls: 0
  - status: staged
<!-- openclaw:dreaming:light:end -->

<!-- openclaw:dreaming:rem:start -->
### Reflections
- No strong patterns surfaced.

### Possible Lasting Truths
- No strong candidate truths surfaced.
<!-- openclaw:dreaming:rem:end -->
```

**Generated session corpus** (`memory/.dreams/session-corpus/2026-07-08.txt`, 654 bytes, exists: YES):
```
[main/sessions/main/surrogate-proof.jsonl#L2] User: I found a bug in the yyyyy...yyy
[main/sessions/main/surrogate-proof.jsonl#L3] Assistant: Investigating th
```

The session corpus snippet is truncated cleanly at the boundary — the emoji that sat at position 279-280 in the input text is correctly dropped by `truncateUtf16Safe`. Both files pass code-unit-level lone surrogate verification (0 surrogates detected).

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/src/surrogate-proof.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose
 ✓ generated daily markdown and session corpus have no lone surrogates
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
```

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-phases.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  50 passed (50)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/normalization-core/src/utf16-slice.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  18 passed (18)
```

### 3. Import boundary

`extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-phases.ts:6`:
```typescript
import { truncateUtf16Safe } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/memory-core-host-engine-foundation";
```
This is the standard SDK facade, matching the existing usage in `manager-search.ts` in the same extension.

### What was NOT tested

Full production workspace dreaming sweep. Covered by: 50 unit tests + 18 utf16-slice tests + surrogate-proof dreaming sweep test asserting both daily markdown and session corpus output + standalone 5-site truncation proof script.

**Proof scripts**:
- `scripts/proof/dreaming-surrogate-truncation-proof.mjs` — exercises all 5 call sites
- `extensions/memory-core/src/surrogate-proof.test.ts` — full pipeline sweep
